area.source: GOB 343 stores selected-hostile selector 3 and a 5 m radius. Miasma 2.0 is a single application.

area.test: SelectedFieldUsesThePrimaryCentreAndEachRecipientOwnContest checks an exact five-metre splash recipient seven metres from the caster, a 5.01 m exclusion, same-organization and hidden exclusions, and separate primary and secondary rolls.

targeting.source: GOB 343 selects a hostile no more than 16 m away, requires Hacker Style outside combat, and stores the viral test and no sight bypass.
targeting.runtime: AbilityHandler checks a live loaded selection before the cast and revalidates its spawn and reach before landing. The normal selected hostile resolver admits the centre and checks sight and each recipient contest.
targeting.test: SelectedFieldUsesTheAdmittedLiveSpawnAndCannotSplashAfterInvalidation covers empty/stale/ally/range/sight/style/combat and a paid invalidation. SelectedFieldUsesThePrimaryCentreAndEachRecipientOwnContest checks the deflected primary leaves a separate successful splash.

behavior-tests.source: GOB 343 stores a 2 s cast, 14 IS, 28 s reuse, and -21 Melee and Ballistic Defense for 45 s.
behavior-tests.runtime: The selected hostile resolver sends one field application. TimedEffects and AbilityStats supply both defense consumers and expire the records.
behavior-tests.test: MiasmaTwoChangesBothDefenseConsumersAndNaturallyClears verifies the typed defenses. SelectedFieldUsesThePrimaryCentreAndEachRecipientOwnContest checks actual non-damaging splash, the independent deflection branch, and expiry. The exact stock Code Nuke bootstrap verifies the shared selector and actual boundary receipts.
